Yolanda Maritz Part 3

By: Tarryn Crossman | Paid

Proposal


Show:

Unique Selling Point:

The midwife killer is back

The beginning of the story
In 2020, we first broke the story of Yolande Maritz, a midwife who was using an extremely dangerous drug called Cytotec to speed up their natural deliveries without her patient's consent. We were given first-hand accounts by two of her staff, including her daughter, on how she would dissolve the drug into water or energy drinks and then give it to her clients without them knowing.
Cytotec is an extremely dangerous induction drug, which can only be used in a medical setting. Because of its potency and the dangers to the foetus, only a ¼ of a tablet is usually used by DOCTORs to bring on labour. According to her staff, Martitz would dissolve a whole tablet.
The Cytotec would cause the uterus to contract faster and faster. If the cervix wasn’t open for the baby to come out, these contractions ended up asphyxiating the unborn children. We reported on four babies that died and three that landed up with CP due to a lack of oxygen in the first few minutes of life, which specialists confirmed could be blamed on the Cytotec.

It is also a drug that only doctors can prescribe, but we had evidence that she was prescribing it to her patients and confronted her about it in our original interview. It’s a great moment.

During our investigation, we discovered that Yolanda’s dangerous practices had started way back in Bloemfontein around 2016. Many women landed up in the ER of a local hospital, where the OBs eventually said they would no longer support a YM lead delivery. She had a case in Bloem against her where a baby died, and one got CP, so she moved her practice to Pretoria.

But there was more than just the Cytotec. Yolanda was acting like a lone ranger midwife. Her practices were dangerous and reckless, and the mother and babies birthing with her were paying the price.

From various bad practices of Yolanda Maritz, we found three dead babies, which we reported on in story 2. Specialists supported all allegations.

Redemption from stories 1 and 2
After our first two stories and under constant pressure from the moms we featured, SANC finally held a hearing for Yolanda Maritz in 2021 – we have footage from outside the hearing and audio from inside – she was banned from practising for five years.

The moms take the case to Afriforum, who start fighting to get the NPA to take their case

Whispers
At the beginning of last year, the moms of the dead and injured babies started getting tip-offs on Social media that Yolanda was shopping for an ultrasound machine and other birthing equipment. They then started seeing her and her new husband Paul Fouche’s business advertised online. They were doing 4D scans. To do ultrasounds, you must be registered with the HSPCA – I still have to verify; they are not coming back to me, but I doubt she is registered.

Alysia – one of the moms whose baby died – makes a big deal of it on socials and slates YM. YM closed the pages and sent Alysia a lawyer’s letter for defamation.
Alysia sets up a social media profile in her deceased son Noah’s name and continues to get tip-off about Yolanda’s every move.

She is back
She has been doing diagnostic Sonars all over Pretoria - I have confirmed several clients - and we can now confirm that she is still delivering babies, exclusively doing home births, under the name Judah Birth Services.

Her target for ultrasounds and births is younger, less fortunate people who don’t want to go to a state facility, but it's their only option.

TIP off 1 – DR Rebotile from Karabo Medical Center was referring YM to her clients.
She was willing to speak but then shut down after speaking to SANC.
We are still working on her, but we have her audio-recorded speaking to me about the one birth.

Estelle was seeing Yolanda for scans, and YM offered to deliver her baby. She bragged about recently delivering twins, but Estelle wasn’t interested in a home birth. She has had multiple miscarriages and wants to give birth in a hospital. She saw Noah’s page and contacted Alysia, who contacted me. Estelle agreed to film her following scan with YM and discuss birthing options with her. YM confirmed that she could do the home delivery for 15k and provided the couple with a contract. We filmed this on a hidden cellphone, but you can see Yolanda clearly and her crazy husband Paul – more about him now.

YM also gave Estelle a contact for a delivery she did in August last year and confirmed that she has safely caught over 2000 babies in her career.
I will contact her and get her to speak to us.

The criminal case and SANC
Afriforum pushed for 2 years and finally at the end of 2023 the NPA announced that they will be prosecuting YM on 6 counts of assault – 3 adults and 3 babies
None of the new evidence we have discovered has been included in that case
SANC have been informed – we will more than likely get a written response from them

The confront.
My idea is to get Estelle to ask her to come for a scan or meeting, and then we can confront her there.
I will ask her for an interview, but there is no way she will do it.
PS. She has had her little henchman husband call and threaten me a few times, so she and Paul will be wild mad with a confrontation.

Original story was 20 minutes at the old CB pace of 100km per hour. And It was broadcast in 2020, so I really think we can give this beat some decent time.

Further information:

PAUL FOUCHE – he was a paramedic. YM started working with him as a paramedic while the whole Midwife thing was falling apart. He also used to run a crime scene clean-up business. I have photos of his page in my archives.
He is a tiny, angry, paranoid guy. When he goes to the scans, all the couples have told me how he is the one who says they are not allowed to film YM or his face or mention their names because of the popi act. He makes them sign a form that says they can never say anything about her and Paul due to the Popi act. I have one of them.
She also doesn’t put her name or practice number on the scans.

Yolanda and Paul got married after this whole thing unfolded, and she changed her surname to Fouche, which is also why she wouldn’t come up if anyone searched Yolanda Maritz.
We have great footage of him from the 1st story yelling at Derek to cut the cameras, etc. They also brought their cameras to film our interview.

VO Cytotec is used off script as an induction drug. It is listed by the United States’ Food and Drug Administration to cause birth defects, premature birth, uterine rupture, miscarriage and incomplete miscarriage. Because of its potency and risk to the foetus, doctors told us they would use only a quarter of a tablet to bring on labour. According to Estune, her mother would dissolve no less than a whole tablet in water or an energy drink to give to her patients How many patients got Cytotec Estune: if you birthed at You and Me you got Cytotec VO Cytotec over stimulates the uterus, so there isn't enough space between contractions for the baby to get enough oxygen, and it goes into distress. The Doula in this video confirmed that Cariens baby's heartbeat had dropped to 90 beats per minute. There was no doubt that she was in distress. But instead of following protocol, informing the family, and immediately transferring Carien for an emergency C-section, Maritz said nothing and continued with the home birth CARIEN after I drank a bottle of waterI couldn't cope with the contractions anymore. , there was no break. It was contraction upon contraction Carien’s daughter would later be diagnosed with cerebral palsy, which is a birth injury caused by hypoxia or a lack of oxygen during labour. but she was only one y 1 of many infants we traced who had been diagnosed, after been delivered by Maritz But Back in 2020, when we confronted Maritz about using cytec she denied everything DEREK you denying this use of cytotec and yet virtually every patient was given a prescription for cytotec Show me the prescription. Derek: What about this one DEREK: You told us you never prescribe it. YM: Okay this is for bleeding this is not for the induction of labor. DEREK: You told us you never prescribe it. YM: Okay. metadata.Unique Selling Point: The midwife killer is back The beginning of the story In 2020, we first broke the story of Yolande Maritz, a midwife who was using an extremely dangerous drug called Cytotec to speed up their natural deliveries without her patient's consent. We were given first-hand accounts by two of her staff, including her daughter, on how she would dissolve the drug into water or energy drinks and then give it to her clients without them knowing. Cytotec is an extremely dangerous induction drug, which can only be used in a medical setting. Because of its potency and the dangers to the foetus, only a ¼ of a tablet is usually used by DOCTORs to bring on labour. According to her staff, Martitz would dissolve a whole tablet. The Cytotec would cause the uterus to contract faster and faster. If the cervix wasn’t open for the baby to come out, these contractions ended up asphyxiating the unborn children. We reported on four babies that died and three that landed up with CP due to a lack of oxygen in the first few minutes of life, which specialists confirmed could be blamed on the Cytotec. It is also a drug that only doctors can prescribe, but we had evidence that she was prescribing it to her patients and confronted her about it in our original interview. It’s a great moment. During our investigation, we discovered that Yolanda’s dangerous practices had started way back in Bloemfontein around 2016. Many women landed up in the ER of a local hospital, where the OBs eventually said they would no longer support a YM lead delivery. She had a case in Bloem against her where a baby died, and one got CP, so she moved her practice to Pretoria. But there was more than just the Cytotec. Yolanda was acting like a lone ranger midwife. Her practices were dangerous and reckless, and the mother and babies birthing with her were paying the price. From various bad practices of Yolanda Maritz, we found three dead babies, which we reported on in story 2. Specialists supported all allegations. Redemption from stories 1 and 2 After our first two stories and under constant pressure from the moms we featured, SANC finally held a hearing for Yolanda Maritz in 2021 – we have footage from outside the hearing and audio from inside – she was banned from practising for five years. The moms take the case to Afriforum, who start fighting to get the NPA to take their case Whispers At the beginning of last year, the moms of the dead and injured babies started getting tip-offs on Social media that Yolanda was shopping for an ultrasound machine and other birthing equipment. They then started seeing her and her new husband Paul Fouche’s business advertised online. They were doing 4D scans. To do ultrasounds, you must be registered with the HSPCA – I still have to verify; they are not coming back to me, but I doubt she is registered. Alysia – one of the moms whose baby died – makes a big deal of it on socials and slates YM. YM closed the pages and sent Alysia a lawyer’s letter for defamation. Alysia sets up a social media profile in her deceased son Noah’s name and continues to get tip-off about Yolanda’s every move. She is back She has been doing diagnostic Sonars all over Pretoria - I have confirmed several clients - and we can now confirm that she is still delivering babies, exclusively doing home births, under the name Judah Birth Services. Her target for ultrasounds and births is younger, less fortunate people who don’t want to go to a state facility, but it's their only option. TIP off 1 – DR Rebotile from Karabo Medical Center was referring YM to her clients. She was willing to speak but then shut down after speaking to SANC. We are still working on her, but we have her audio-recorded speaking to me about the one birth. Estelle was seeing Yolanda for scans, and YM offered to deliver her baby. She bragged about recently delivering twins, but Estelle wasn’t interested in a home birth. She has had multiple miscarriages and wants to give birth in a hospital. She saw Noah’s page and contacted Alysia, who contacted me. Estelle agreed to film her following scan with YM and discuss birthing options with her. YM confirmed that she could do the home delivery for 15k and provided the couple with a contract. We filmed this on a hidden cellphone, but you can see Yolanda clearly and her crazy husband Paul – more about him now. YM also gave Estelle a contact for a delivery she did in August last year and confirmed that she has safely caught over 2000 babies in her career. I will contact her and get her to speak to us. The criminal case and SANC Afriforum pushed for 2 years and finally at the end of 2023 the NPA announced that they will be prosecuting YM on 6 counts of assault – 3 adults and 3 babies None of the new evidence we have discovered has been included in that case SANC have been informed – we will more than likely get a written response from them The confront. My idea is to get Estelle to ask her to come for a scan or meeting, and then we can confront her there. I will ask her for an interview, but there is no way she will do it. PS. She has had her little henchman husband call and threaten me a few times, so she and Paul will be wild mad with a confrontation.

metadata.Further information: PAUL FOUCHE – he was a paramedic. YM started working with him as a paramedic while the whole Midwife thing was falling apart. He also used to run a crime scene clean-up business. I have photos of his page in my archives. He is a tiny, angry, paranoid guy. When he goes to the scans, all the couples have told me how he is the one who says they are not allowed to film YM or his face or mention their names because of the popi act. He makes them sign a form that says they can never say anything about her and Paul due to the Popi act. I have one of them. She also doesn’t put her name or practice number on the scans. Yolanda and Paul got married after this whole thing unfolded, and she changed her surname to Fouche, which is also why she wouldn’t come up if anyone searched Yolanda Maritz. We have great footage of him from the 1st story yelling at Derek to cut the cameras, etc. They also brought their cameras to film our interview.
